questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct reported speech form: 'I really enjoyed the concert,' he said to me.
options: He said that he had really enjoyed the concert.
He said that he really enjoyed the concert.
He said to me that he had really enjoyed the concert.
He said to me that he really enjoyed the concert.
questions.answer: He said to me that he had really enjoyed the concert.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice? Choose the option that is in the passive form.
options: The book was written by a famous author.
The book was being written by a famous author.
The book has been written by a famous author.
questions.answer: The book was written by a famous author.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct conditional type: If I _____ more time, I would travel around the world.
Choose the correct discourse marker to complete the sentence: _____ I'm not an expert, I think that idea is quite innovative.
Select the correct collocation: He decided to _____ his career in finance for something more creative.
Which of these sentences uses a dependent preposition correctly? The meeting was _____ account of the bad weather, postponed until next week.
Choose the best word to complete the sentence: The new policy is likely to _____ existing regulations.
Select the correct form to complete the sentence: By the time she arrived, all the guests _____ already left.
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: She has been living here for five years.
She has lived here for five years.
She is living here for five years.
She lived here for five years.
questions.answer: She has been living here for five years.
